scripts.test:tiers: npm run test:contract && npm run test:release
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run coverage:scripts
scripts.coverage: npm --ignore-scripts --prefix packages/ceal-client run coverage && npm --ignore-scripts --prefix packages/ceal-worker-cli run coverage
scripts.lint:types: npm run lint:types:packages && npm run lint:types:tools && npm run lint:types:tests
scripts.lint:types:raw: npm run lint:types:raw:packages && npm run lint:types:raw:tools && npm run lint:types:raw:tests
scripts.lint:types:ts6: tsc6 -p tsconfig.typecheck.json --pretty false --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/ceal-typecheck-ts6.tsbuildinfo && tsc6 -p tsconfig.tools.json --pretty false --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/ceal-tools-typecheck-ts6.tsbuildinfo && tsc6 -p tsconfig.tests.json --pretty false --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/ceal-tests-typecheck-ts6.tsbuildinfo
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run lint:no-legacy-mjs && npm run build && npm run lint:types && npm run lint:unused && npm run lint:reachability && npm run lint:store-lock && npm run lint:duplicate-literal && npm test
scripts.check:unit: npm run lint && npm run lint:no-legacy-mjs && npm run build && npm run lint:types && npm run lint:unused && npm run lint:reachability && npm run lint:store-lock && npm run lint:duplicate-literal && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contract:built
